entries.28dd6a4271547929: The medium-term management plan "Beyond-120" aims, toward the 120th anniversary of the company's founding, to build a foundation for sustainable growth that carries over to the next generation and to pursue the lasting improvement of corporate value. Its basic policies are to rebuild the business portfolio, pursue management conscious of cost of capital, and actively invest in human capital. Following the expected failure to achieve the targets for the final year, it states that it will undertake fundamental reforms, including reviewing the fixed-cost structure and rebuilding the business portfolio.
